_about: Names of the Model Lab's structures, keyed by mesh name: la = Latin after Terminologia Anatomica, en = English, it = Italian. Made by backend/tools/anatomy_model/names.py when the model is built: do not edit this file, a rebuild writes it again. A teacher's corrections go in model_names_corrections.json beside it (same shape; only 'structures' with 'key' and the names to change), which the app reads after this file.
checked_note: The Latin and the Italian were composed from knowledge of the terminology and have not yet been checked by an anatomist.
